name: The Eye of Paleth

narrative.details:
Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light.  It is the treasure of which Fitzsimmons spoke: a Cursed Eye of Paleth.

Take the Cursed Eye of Paleth to the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow, in Menethil Harbor.  Ask him how to remove the Eye's curse.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Cursed Eye of Paleth to Glorin Steelbrow.
narrative.offerRewardText:
An Eye of Paleth? Amazing! Hmm... there's something wrong with this one. You found it on one of those shipwrecks? Well that explains it! But... I didn't know they had such an Eye on the Third Fleet...

It's no wonder Fitzsimmons was so spooked. A Cursed Eye of Paleth is no cause for mirth.
narrative.requestItemsText: That drunk Fitzsimmons sent you to me? Well, you can tell him I don't have any extra ale. He's going to have to panhandle someone else!

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 27 to 30, 6,820 XP in all.

quests.name: The Third Fleet
quests.objectiveText: Buy First Mate Fitzsimmons a Flagon of Mead.

quests.name: The Cursed Crew
quests.objectiveText: Kill 13 Cursed Sailors, 5 Cursed Marines and First Mate Snellig.

quests.name: Lifting the Curse
quests.objectiveText: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor. Use the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.

quests.name: The Eye of Paleth
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Cursed Eye of Paleth to Glorin Steelbrow.

quests.name: Cleansing the Eye
quests.objectiveText: Bring Archbishop Benedictus the Cursed Eye of Paleth.
